# FG-AUTH-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`smart-http`](../../ops/runbooks/smart-http.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_agent_cannot_clone_fetch_or_archive_a_repository_with_a_confidential_document` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このリポジトリには機密の文書がある（または確かめられなかった）ため、AI エージェントのアカウントでは clone・fetch・アーカイブの取得や、CI のログ・診断の読み取りができません。人のアカウントを使ってください。
- en: This repository holds a confidential document (or it could not be checked), so an AI agent's account cannot clone, fetch or download an archive of it, or read its CI logs and diagnosis. Use a person's account.
- id: Repositori ini berisi dokumen rahasia (atau tidak dapat diperiksa), sehingga akun agen AI tidak dapat melakukan clone, fetch, mengunduh arsipnya, atau membaca log dan diagnosis CI-nya. Gunakan akun orang.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 06 D-5, ADR-0026 decision of 2026-11-10 (the safety net), extended to the CI outputs by ADR-0029 decision 5 (M4 C5). An AI agent audience — a token issued with `is_agent`, a service account or a bot (`Principal::is_agent_audience`) — asked for (a) a whole copy of a repository (Smart HTTP clone / fetch: `GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack` or `POST git-upload-pack`; or `GET -/archive/{ref}.{zip|tar.gz}`; authorize() RepoRead on Resource::RepoCopy, forge_auth::authorize_repo_copy) or (b) a CI output — a job's log (`GET …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/jobs/{job_id}/log`, CiLogRead) or a pipeline's diagnosis (`GET …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/diagnosis`, PipelineDiagnosisRead; authorize() on Resource::CiOutput, forge_auth::authorize_ci_output) — and it was refused because a mark was not measured open. For a copy, and for a CI output with `mark_of=tip`, the default branch's tip: `tip_confidential` (forge_checks::confidential found a confidential file there — a spec document with `confidential: true`, a `.md` with `classification: confidential`, its type's default, both keys, or a front matter / type definition that cannot be read), `default_branch_unborn` (HEAD names a branch not born while other refs exist: nothing to measure against, fail closed), `tip_undecided` (the measurement did not complete: its 20 s timeout FG-GIT-0002 operation=confidential_paths, a bound of the document read, or a git error — `check_error` names its code) or `tip_not_measured` (a defect: the route did not measure). For a CI output with `mark_of=pipeline`, the pipeline's own commit as measured when the pipeline was created (`ci_pipelines.copy_mark`, looked at first: it is what the job saw): `pipeline_confidential` or `pipeline_undecided` (the measurement failed then: fail closed, ADR-0029 obligation 4). A job may copy a confidential repository (its pinned copy is never measured), so everything it prints inherits the marks. Persons are never refused; pushes (receive-pack) are unchanged. Git gets the refusal in-band (HTTP 200 and one `ERR` packet: `fatal: remote error: <message> (request_id: …)`); the archive and the CI routes get the JSON 403 (gstn and gstn mcp show it as is). The operating rule is that confidential documents live in repositories the agent's account cannot read — this refusal is the safety net. It looks only at the default branch's tip and the pipeline's commit: a confidential file only in history or on another branch is not detected. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `route` (`info_refs`, `upload_pack`, `archive`, `ci_log`, `ci_diagnosis`), `project_id`, `reason` (above), `audience` (`agent_token`, `service_account`, `bot`) and, for a copy, `repo_id`, `tip` (the default branch's commit), `paths` (the first confidential paths, for `tip_confidential`) and, for `tip_undecided`, `check_error` with the cause's own context (`operation`, `timeout_ms`, `bound`); for a CI output, `mark_of` (`pipeline` or `tip`), `pipeline_id` and (a log) `job_id`. Read the marks at the tip: gstn browse blob --project <id> --ref <tip> --path <path>; the pipeline's: gstn pipeline show --project <id> <pipeline_id> (`copy_mark`).

## 対処 (fix)

Expected for an AI agent. Follow runbook smart-http (agents and confidential documents) for a copy and runbook checks-reporting (CI outputs) for a log or a diagnosis: move the confidential documents to a repository the agent's account cannot read (the operating rule), or read with a person's account. A wrong mark is corrected in the document's front matter (or its type's default); once the default branch's tip has no confidential file the agent can clone again (the answer is cached per repository and tip commit, so a push changes it at once). A pipeline's own mark never changes: run a new pipeline on a commit without the confidential file. `tip_undecided` from a timeout: retry; if it repeats, the repository's documents exceed the bounds — reduce them or use a person's account.
